:_mod-docs-content-type: REFERENCE

[id="dependency-only-providers-reference_{context}"]
= Dependency-only providers reference

[role="_abstract"]
The following providers are classified as dependency-only in {productname-short} 3.5.
Their Python dependencies are pre-installed in the Llama Stack container image, but they are not included in the default runtime `config.yaml`.
To use any of these providers, you must supply a custom `config.yaml` at runtime.

[IMPORTANT]
====
Dependency-only providers are classified as Developer Preview.
They are not intended for production use.
In a future release of {productname-short}, the dependencies for these providers will be removed from the container image entirely.
====

.Dependency-only providers
[cols="2,1,1,3", options="header"]
|===
|Provider |Provider API |Support status |Notes

|`inline::sentence-transformers`
|Inference (embeddings)
|Developer Preview
|Generates vector embeddings using the `sentence-transformers` library inside the Llama Stack container.
For production use, deploy an embedding model with vLLM and use `remote::vllm` with the `VLLM_EMBEDDING_URL` environment variable.

|`inline::milvus`
|Vector_IO
|Developer Preview
|Runs Milvus Lite as an in-process vector store using a local database file.
Incompatible with multi-worker deployments because the local database file cannot be shared across worker processes.
For production use, deploy an external Milvus service and use `remote::milvus` with the `MILVUS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

|`inline::faiss`
|Vector_IO
|Developer Preview
|Runs FAISS as an in-process vector store.
For production use, deploy a PostgreSQL instance with the pgvector extension and use `remote::pgvector`, or deploy a Qdrant vector database and use `remote::qdrant`.
|===

[id="required-configuration-stanzas_{context}"]
== Required configuration stanzas

To re-enable a dependency-only provider, add the corresponding configuration stanza to your custom `config.yaml`.
The following stanzas are sourced from the `build.yaml` provider manifest.

`inline::sentence-transformers`:: Add the following entry to the `inference` section of your custom `config.yaml`:
+
[source,yaml]
----
  - provider_id: sentence-transformers
    provider_type: inline::sentence-transformers
    config: {}
----

`inline::milvus`:: Add the following entry to the `vector_io` section of your custom `config.yaml`:
+
[source,yaml]
----
  - provider_id: milvus
    provider_type: inline::milvus
    config:
      db_path: /opt/app-root/src/.ogx/distributions/rh/milvus.db
      persistence:
        backend: kv_default
        namespace: vector_io::milvus
----
+
[WARNING]
====
The `inline::milvus` provider is incompatible with multi-worker deployments.
Milvus Lite uses a local database file that cannot be shared across worker processes.
Use `inline::milvus` only for single-replica deployments during development and testing.
====

`inline::faiss`:: Add the following entry to the `vector_io` section of your custom `config.yaml`:
+
[source,yaml]
----
  - provider_id: faiss
    provider_type: inline::faiss
    config:
      persistence:
        backend: kv_default
        namespace: vector_io::faiss
----

[id="providers-not-affected_{context}"]
== Providers not affected

The `inline::localfs` provider remains in the default runtime `config.yaml` and is not classified as dependency-only.
The `inline::file-search` tool runtime depends on `inline::localfs`, so it is not stripped from the default configuration.
